LESSON: SHARIAH RELIGION INTELLECT LIFE PROPERTY DIGNITY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.1: Shariah religion intellect life property dignity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Shariah religion intellect life property dignity. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the objective of Maqasid Shariah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the purpose of Islamic Shariah (Maqasid al-Shariah) as a guide for Muslims
2. describe the categories of legal acts in Islamic Shariah as a means of upholding divine guidance
3. apply Islamic Shariah in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SHARIAH RELIGION INTELLECT LIFE PROPERTY DIGNITY
